stories.title: AI detects "invisible" signs of pancreatic cancer years before diagnosis
stories.synopsis: A new AI system called REDMOD can pick up extremely subtle changes in pancreatic tissue that may signal cancer more than a year before it shows up on conventional scans, according to research published in the journal Gut. It outperformed experienced radiologists in the study, which raises hopes for earlier, potentially lifesaving treatment. Researchers say more work is needed before it reaches routine care.

stories.title: Microsoft medical AI correctly diagnoses 83% of complex cases in new study
stories.synopsis: In a study published in Science, a Microsoft AI diagnostic system correctly identified 83% of complex medical cases, compared with 36% for generalist physicians. It works like a panel of doctors, with several AI agents challenging one another's conclusions as new information arrives. The result came under simulated test conditions, but it suggests AI could one day help doctors solve some of medicine's toughest diagnostic puzzles.

stories.title: AI Model's Predictions Accurate Enough to Quickly Improve Medical Decisions
stories.synopsis: NYU Langone researchers have built Lang1, a family of AI models trained on records from more than 10 million patients over 20 years of care. The study describes designing, testing and deploying it in real-world settings. It can help doctors and hospital leaders predict which patients may decline in the hospital or return soon after discharge, so everyday decisions about care can be better informed.
